  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech V Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  Natural Language Processing [CSE-3172]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           For each of the following sentences, identify the type of ambiguity present. Classify  
  each sentence as either structural ambiguity, semantic ambiguity, or pragmatic  
  ambiguity.  
  A)      1. Time flies like an arrow                                                                   (3)  
  2. He crushed the key to my heart  
  3. John hit Bill  
  
  B)      Define Finite State Transducer(FST). Explain the general functions of FST which is not  
  in the FSA(Finite State Automata).                                                     (5)  
  
  C)      Illustrate the need of two tapes in finite state morphology with suitable example.            (2)  
  2)           Draw a finite state transducer (FST) that recognizes the suffix -ly associated with regular  
  adverbs in English. Demonstrate that your FST handles cases like 'quick' → 'quickly'.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply minimum edit distance algorithm for the given input's "algorithm" and "alligator".  
  Consider cost operation is 1.                                                            (3)  
  
  C)      Examine the strengths and limitations of stemming and provide a Python code example  
  to illustrate the stemming process.                                                           (4)  
  
  3)           For the given sentences:  
  
  • Birds can fly in the sky  
  A)          • Sky is blue during the day  
  • Day turns into night                                                                    (5)  
  • Night is dark and quiet  
  
  Learn a bi-gram model. Show the probabilities of all the words and estimate the  
  probability for the sentence "Birds can fly in the sky Night is dark and quiet".  
  
  B)      Define Parts Of Speech tagging(POS). Identify and explain the Applications of POS .           (3)  
  C)      Explain the working principle of Viterbi algorithm .                                          (2)  
  4)           Discuss different types of error challenges in PoS tagging. List few techniques which are (5)
